about: Every request to re-measure something we published, and what happened to it. Nothing is removed from this file. A correction is appended; the record it corrects keeps its original hash and stays published.

policy.who_may_ask: anyone, including someone we measured without being asked
policy.deletion: there is no procedure to delete a record, including a wrong one. a correction is appended.
policy.response_time: not promised. we do not run a staffed desk and will not invent a number we cannot keep.

note: corrections is empty on 2026-08-19 because nobody has asked yet, not because nothing has been wrong. Three of our own counts were wrong before the published one; that is written on the report itself.
